name: Capicola
siboNotes: Generally well-tolerated for SIBO as it's a plain cured meat. Choose varieties without garlic or onion powder if sensitive.
preparationTips: Check ingredient labels for FODMAP-containing seasonings like garlic powder
Serve at room temperature for best flavor
Pair with low-FODMAP crackers or cheese
Store properly refrigerated and consume within recommended timeframe
nutritionalHighlights: High in protein for muscle maintenance
Good source of B vitamins, especially B12
